data.title: Cold War Missile Silo and Command Bunker
data.summary: A generic 1960s to 1980s hardened launch facility: the sectioned silo and its headworks, the buried launch control capsule, the fenced surface site, period support vehicles and crew equipment.
data.description: A strategic launch site of the deterrent era, modelled in metre units with original generic hardware. The silo chapter sections a concrete launch tube open so the steel liner, work platforms, launch mount and umbilical mast are all visible, and adds the headworks collar, the sliding ballistic closure, a two stage missile with its shroud, the exhaust duct and the personnel access shaft. The launch control chapter sections the buried capsule open along its length and fits it out with console banks, crew chairs on floor rails, shock isolators, the entry blast door with its locking wheel, an authenticator safe, communications racks, air handling and a bunk alcove. The surface chapter supplies a modular perimeter fence on a 4 metre grid with corners, ends and a gated sentry post, plus antennas, a generator house, a water tower, a fuel tank cap, a hardened entry portal and a helipad. Four support vehicles and thirteen period props complete the site. No real designations, unit names, country names, flags or insignia appear anywhere. Static CC0 geometry prepared for human review.
